description: A configurable outbound connector for BPMN Service Tasks (serviceType="connector"). Declares the provider, its canvas icon, how it authenticates and how it executes. Operations (and their fields) live in BPMN Connector Operation.

fields.description: Stable id used in the BPMN XML (spiffworkflow:connectorId). Lowercase with underscores, e.g. google_drive.
fields.label: Connector ID

fields.description: Shown in the Connector dropdown in the modeler.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Disabled connectors disappear from the modeler and refuse to dispatch.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Who may use this connector. Leave empty to allow every user who can open the modeler. Restricting it hides the connector from the Service Task panel and refuses it at runtime.
fields.label: Allowed Roles

fields.description: The d attribute of a single SVG path on a 24×24 viewBox (e.g. paste from an MDI icon). Drawn on the Service Task in place of the gear. Leave blank for the default plug.
fields.label: Icon SVG Path

fields.description: Hex colour for the icon, e.g. #14b8a6.
fields.label: Icon Colour

fields.description: Tooltip/label for the icon (defaults to Label).
fields.label: Icon Label

fields.description: HTTP Request — fully configured here, no Python needed. Python Handler — dispatch to a registered @connector handler (or an operation's Handler Path); use for SDK-based providers.
fields.label: Execution Type

fields.description: Prefixed to each operation's relative URL, e.g. https://api.example.com/v2.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Seconds before an HTTP call is abandoned.
fields.label: Request Timeout (s)

fields.description: Off (recommended): loopback, link-local and private-range hosts are refused, so a connector cannot be pointed at internal infrastructure. Turn on only for a deliberate internal integration.
fields.label: Allow Internal Hosts

fields.description: How the secret is presented. Service Account JSON is handled by the Python handlers (Google) rather than the HTTP executor.
fields.label: Auth Type
fields.options:
None
Bearer Token
API Key Header
API Key Query Param
Basic
Service Account JSON

fields.description: On this connector — type the secret below; it is encrypted and never leaves the server. From a settings DocType — read it from a Password field elsewhere, for a credential several connectors share (how the Google connectors reuse one service account).
fields.label: Credential Source
fields.options:
On this connector
From a settings DocType

fields.depends_on: eval:doc.auth_type && doc.auth_type!='None' && doc.credential_source!='From a settings DocType'
fields.description: For Service Account JSON, paste the whole key file Google issued. Stored encrypted and never returned by the API, an export, or the modeler manifest.
For Service Account JSON, paste the whole key file Google issued — every brace, the full private_key, nothing trimmed. For the other auth types this is the token, API key, or user:password.
fields.label: Secret
fields.mandatory_depends_on: eval:doc.auth_type=='Service Account JSON' && doc.credential_source!='From a settings DocType'

fields.description: Single DocType holding the shared secret, e.g. Processa Settings. Read with get_password at call time.
fields.label: Secret Settings DocType

fields.description: Password fieldname on that settings DocType, e.g. github_token. It must be a Password field, so the secret is stored encrypted.
fields.label: Secret Fieldname

fields.description: One OAuth scope per line. Google refuses a token request with no scope, so this is required for a service account. Two connectors may share a key and ask for different scopes.
fields.label: Scopes

fields.description: Query-string parameter carrying the key, e.g. api_key.
fields.label: API Key Query Param

fields.description: Reference only — never fetched at runtime.
fields.label: Discovery Document URL

name: BPMN Connector
